mapper.sql: booking_id,order_no,user_id, room_id,check_in_date,check_out_date, total_price,guest_name,guest_phone, special_request,status,payment_time, transaction_id,cancel_time,cancel_reason, create_time,update_time
mapper.select: select h.hotel_id, h.name as hotel_name, hrt.room_type_id, hrt.name as room_type_name, hr.room_id, hr.room_no, h.address, hrt.price, case when not exists( select 1 from hotel_booking hb where hb.room_id=hr.room_id and hb.status IN (0, 1, 2) and hb.check_in_date < #{endDate} and hb.check_out_date > #{startDate} ) then true else false end as has_empty_room, case when not exists( select 1 from hotel_booking hb where hb.room_id=hr.room_id and hb.status IN (0, 1, 2) and hb.check_in_date < #{endDate} and hb.check_out_date > #{startDate} ) then NOW() else ( select min(hb2.check_out_date) from hotel_booking hb2 where hr.room_id=hb2.room_id and hb2.status IN (0, 1, 2) and hb2.check_out_date > #{startDate} ) end as available_book_time from hotel h join hotel_room_type hrt on h.hotel_id=hrt.hotel_id join hotel_room hr on hrt.room_type_id=hr.room_type_id and h.hotel_id=hr.hotel_id where h.city=#{city}
